method: gh repo list aivara-se --limit 1000 --json name,description,isArchived,primaryLanguage,defaultBranchRef,updatedAt ; gh api repos/aivara-se/<repo> (permissions.push, pushed_at) ; gh api repos/aivara-se/<repo>/git/trees/<default-branch>?recursive=1 (file presence; truncated=false for all seven)

conventionsObserved.agentsFile: 5 of 7 repos carry an AGENTS.md and all five differ (distinct blob SHAs: bot-mama 7758ea27e3d305e47b2c416adbb9697cda61b9e9, bot-meme 66a479624a83550d73d724011525a66db3bdf179, bot-mimi cdf6ee29d25447643dcc40410024d167990f9014, bot-momo 085c1e1914029e7b56852870d676c367c0d46b48, bot-website 45f35fbf159fb8ecda8c7ce8da010f875bdc459a) — every one is repo-specific prose and must be merged into, not replaced.
conventionsObserved.agentsDir: No repo has .agents/ — the skills convention is new everywhere in this org.
conventionsObserved.sharedSiteTooling: The four bot-* sites plus bot-website share byte-identical docs/DESIGN.md, docs/PRODUCT.md, docs/SYSTEM.md, assets/fonts/ and scripts/verify-site.sh (blob 8430480e08fe29d2e1b2a9aa8f4477b3a674e82f); only AGENTS.md, README.md, assets/avatar.webp, index.html and log.html differ.
conventionsObserved.runtimes: JS work is Bun-first (aivara.se pins bun@1.4.2 via packageManager and .npmrc engine-strict=true). The five site repos have no JS runtime at all.
conventionsObserved.defaultBranches: All seven repos use main as the default branch, and none is protected.
